I came in because I was worried that my daughter might have chickenpox and wanted to see if a doctor could check her. Unfortunately, the receptionist, Amy, was extremely rude and unhelpful from the start.

Even after I explained that I was concerned and felt it was urgent, she refused to even check if a doctor might be available to see us, simply because we didn’t have an appointment. Her attitude was dismissive and lacked any sense of empathy or understanding for the situation.

What made the experience worse was being told that “for small things like that” we should just go to a pharmacy. As a parent, it’s very distressing to have your concerns brushed off like that, especially when you’re worried about your child’s health.

I understand that appointments are important and policies exist, but basic courtesy and compassion should always come first. This experience left me feeling frustrated, unsupported, and reluctant to return.",null,[0,240]]]],[null,1773914499000000,1773914499000000,"3 days ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/206769871891651054/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnQwVEZZeVpGRk1XRlkxVWxSWk0yVkdVazVPV0dSRlVXczFlVkpIWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/206769871891651054/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnQwVEZZeVpGRk1XRlkxVWxSWk0yVkdVazVPV0dSRlVXczFlVkpIWXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/206769871891651054/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnQwVEZZeVpGRk1XRlkxVWxSWk0yVkdVazVPV0dSRlVXczFlVkpIWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/206769871891651054/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnQwVEZZeVpGRk1XRlkxVWxSWk0yVkdVazVPV0dSRlVXczFlVkpIWXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/206769871891651054/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnQwVEZZeVpGRk1XRlkxVWxSWk0yVkdVazVPV0dSRlVXczFlVkpIWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/206769871891651054/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnQwVEZZeVpGRk1XRlkxVWxSWk0yVkdVazVPV0dSRlVXczFlVkpIWXhBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Thank you for taking the time to share your recent experience at Broad Street Health Centre.
